name: The king's son
description: The king's firstborn son and a dragon-killer heir, who overthrew his father's supporters and died fighting the second wife.

description_citations.text: "Dragon-killers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas sows discord among the heirs and inspires the king's son to overthrow his father.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas immediately set about sowing discord, suspicion, ambition, and mistrust among them.

citation.text: "Dragon-killers' War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The son takes the central settlement, kills the chief's supporters and installs himself on the throne.
timeline.quote: he killed the chief's supporters and installed himself on the throne.

citation.text: "Dragon-killers' War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The king's son and second wife stab each other and die; the dragon-killers are dead and Bolas takes rule over their people.
timeline.quote: And so, the dragon killers were dead, and Nicol Bolas assumed the reign over their people.

citation.text: "Dragon-killers' War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
